reviews.review_title: Review at Banh Mi Trung Luong
reviews.review_text:
Ray Ray Ray
Dubai, United Arab Emirates936 contributions
0
Overall, it’s all right.
May 2023 • Solo
Chả bò is a traditional Vietnamese sausage. It is made from fresh lean beef (usually top round roast or steak), spices, seasonings, and fish sauce. The beef is ground, seasoned with spices, then wrapped in banana leaves and steamed or fried. The leaves also impart flavor to the cooked sausage.

In this case, the banh mi is stuffed with cha and not much else. Can’t really detect a difference between the thap cam and the dac biet variety, maybe there is some variance between the beef and the pork version.

Overall, it’s all right. Can’t say I was blown away and could definitely suggest they kick it up a notch with green chillies or similar.

In my case, I used some scorpion pepper sauce from Mulligans in Saigon.

Finally, before going to this restaurant, you might want to check on ShopeeFood. This branch is known to put sandwiches on sale for 5K from time to time.

Would I come back? Probably not. Nothing really here keep me coming back for more.
